items.name: Itapeva 2026

venue.name: Secretaria do Esportes de Itapeva
venue.address: Av. Paulina de Morais, 438 - Vila Ofelia, Itapeva - SP, 18400-818

items.information:
🇧🇷 **Português:**
Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Itapeva2026/register).
Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, leia o [regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU).
Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

🇬🇧 **English:**
Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Itapeva2026/register) tab.
If this is your first time competing, read the [WCA Regulation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by watching this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU).
There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Edinburgh Winter 2026

venue.name: Meadowbank Sports Centre
venue.details: Hall 3, Second floor, follow the signs

items.information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events:
- 4x4 BLD/5x5 BLD: first 20 to register
Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 20 to register for these events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping a waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.

items.information:

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:00 AM.

items.name: Agoura Winter 2026
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AgouraWinter2026#67112-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
